text.style: font-size: 6.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif', serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #303942

g.text: Common limits: 60 candidates; 10 records; 12,000 serialized evidence bytes. No reader-accuracy or harm claim.

g.text: Unavailable support stays NA. Gold annotations may be incomplete. Descriptive paired pilot; no p-values or CI.
